image_description: A high-angle, medium shot of a large pipe organ situated in a church or cathedral setting. The image features a prominent array of vertical metallic pipes of varying heights arranged symmetrically behind an ornate, gilded wooden balustrade. A stained glass window is visible in the background between the pipe sections. The foreground shows the decorative casing and part of the organ's structure, but the console (keyboards and pedalboard) is not visible.
